messages:
sarah-ops: Quick sync — external pen-test booked for Tue 2026-03-10. Need to finalize RBAC snapshot, KMS access posture, and an evidence packaging plan. Who owns the remediation tracker?
omar-sec: I can own the tracker. High-level constraints: no KMS decrypt for assessors, ephemeral roles only, audit stream to be exported. Suggest ephemeral role TTL = 4h. :thumbsup:
jia-sre: Fine with ephemeral roles. I'll prepare CloudTrail/CloudWatch export and ensure log retention is set to 90d for the snapshot. We should also restrict source IPs to the assessor CIDR.
sec-bot: PenTest intake created: PT-2026-03 ID 9876. Scope doc requested. Please attach in thread or add to the intake ticket.
sarah-ops: Adding quick checklist to thread so we don't lose it: 1) RBAC: create assessor role + session policy (4h) 2) KMS: do NOT grant Decrypt, avoid direct key access 3) Artifacts: produce sanitized S3 artifacts or presigned URLs 4) Logs: generate signed export + checksum 5) Remediation board: single epic + tickets per finding.
omar-sec: On KMS — assessors should not get Decrypt. If they need to validate encryption flows, we can provide pre-generated plaintext test vectors and envelope metadata. If the assessor insists on decrypt capability, that should be handled in a controlled readroom with our engineer present.
jia-sre: Agreed. For artifact access, presigned URLs + S3:GetObject is ideal. We'll also provide an export of relevant CloudTrail events as a gzipped bundle. Example minimal session policy I plan to attach to the ephemeral role:
```json
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:GetObject"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::pt-artifacts/*"] }, { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["logs:GetLogEvents", "logs:DescribeLogStreams"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:123456789012:log-group:/redwood/*"] } ] }
```
jia-sre: I'll drop the export to the intake ticket and create presigned URLs with 7-day expiry.
omar-sec: Created remediation epic REM-EPIC-342 and initial ticket REM-342-1 for vuln triage. Link: https://tracker.internal/REM-EPIC-342. I'll post triage notes and assign to squads.
oncall: I'll be oncall for the week of the test (2026-03-08 -> 2026-03-15). If anything spikes, page me.
sarah-ops: Proposed retest window: 2026-03-20 10:00-14:00 PT (7 days after fix merges). Is that okay?
omar-sec: Works for me. Recommend we require fixes merged + CI green by 72h before retest. Also want a dry-run with the assessor to validate access flow — propose dry-run tomorrow 16:00.
jia-sre: Dry-run ack. I'll create the ephemeral role and push the presigned artifact links to the readroom channel before 15:30.
sarah-ops: Perfect. Omar — please add the assessor contact and exact CIDR to the intake ticket. Also attach the log export checksum.
omar-sec: Done. Intake ticket updated with assessor contact + CIDR + link to REM-EPIC-342.
sarah-ops: Thanks everyone. Final actions: Omar owns remediation board, Jia prepares artifacts/export, I'll coordinate readroom and retest slot. Dry-run 16:00 tomorrow. Closing this thread — follow-ups in the intake ticket and REM epic. :white_check_mark:
